raw_market.question: 1Q Spread: Penn State (-3.5)
raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the college football game between USC and Penn State, scheduled for October 10 at 7:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Penn State" if Penn State outscore USC by 4 or more points in the first quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "USC".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
